verdict.rationale: Sunbiz does recognize a registered agent, a sanctioned third-party role: the annual-report e-file lets an entity change its registered agent and registered office address (docs-10) and update authorized members, managers and officers (docs-9). Beyond that, the evidence does not describe how an outside provider is authorized to file or act on the company's behalf. missing for 10: documentation of the registered agent's duties and authority, any designee or authorized-filer or representative mechanism for third-party providers, rules for provider accounts, and independent corroboration.
